wizards.xyz.name: XYZ travel check
wizards.xyz.description: Measure X, Y and Z travel and check deviations with repeated measurements.
xyz.intro: Check the actual travel of each axis using a dial indicator or securely mounted caliper. Measure every tested axis at least three times.
xyz.hardware: This test does not change axis settings. Klipper recommends determining XYZ rotation_distance from belts, pulleys and lead screws. If results differ, first check the mechanics, backlash and measuring setup.
xyz.cube.info: Optional print test: your test cube has nominal dimensions of 20 × 20 × 20 mm. Printed dimensions are also affected by material and slicer settings and do not replace travel measurements.
xyz.home.info: Clear the build volume and tool. Install the measuring device only after homing. All axes will be homed with G28.
xyz.prepare.title: Prepare measurement
xyz.prepare.info: If needed, position the axes in Mainsail for your measuring setup. Then select axis, direction and distance. “Check start position” records the current position without moving. For repeats, first return to the start and zero the measuring device again.
xyz.clearance: Start and end need 2 mm clearance from axis limits and at least 5 mm Z height. Also check that the tool and measuring device can move freely.
xyz.speed: Speed (mm/s, X/Y up to 10, Z up to 2)
xyz.move.title: Measure axis {axis}
xyz.zero: Zero the measuring device at the recorded start position. The next move only moves the selected axis.
xyz.move.safety: Keep hands clear of the motion area. Measure only after the axis has stopped.
xyz.confirm: The measuring device is zeroed and the travel path is clear.
xyz.measure.title: Read travel of {axis}
xyz.measure.info: Requested travel: {distance} mm. Enter the actual measured travel as a positive value.
xyz.result.title: XYZ measurement results
xyz.result.explanation: A positive deviation means excessive travel, a negative one insufficient travel. The range shows the spread of deviations. For repeatability, compare measurements with the same distance and direction. Untested axes have not been evaluated.
xyz.errors.position: Current position or axis limits could not be determined safely.
xyz.errors.bounds: Start or end is too close to an axis limit. Reposition the printer or choose another distance/direction.
xyz.errors.clearance: Start and end must have at least 5 mm Z height for this test.
xyz.errors.settings: Choose a distance of 1–100 mm and a positive speed up to 10 mm/s for X/Y or 2 mm/s for Z.
xyz.errors.changed: The position was changed outside the wizard. End the test and begin with a new start position.
xyz.errors.measurement: Enter a positive, finite measurement up to 200 mm.
xyz.errors.repeats: Each series with the same axis, distance and direction needs at least three measurements for evaluation.
xyz.errors.step: This action is not allowed at the current measurement step.
xyz.errors.homing: All axes must be homed before the test.
xyz.errors.kinematics: This travel check currently supports Cartesian, CoreXY and CoreXZ.
xyz.errors.active: End the active calibration before starting another workflow.
